blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — A 27-year-old Police Non-Commissioned Officer (PNCO) died after his firearm was accidentally discharged at 12:30 a.m. on Friday in Barangay Caranoche, Santa Catalina, Negros Oriental. According to an initial investigation by the Santa Catalina Municipal Police Station, personnel responded to the scene after a concerned citizen reported the incident. Witness accounts indicate that the victim was having a drinking session with acquaintances outside a residence when he reportedly drew his firearm to demonstrate how it operates. While he was handling the weapon, it suddenly went off, striking him in the forehead, a witness told police investigators. READ: Boy […]...
